cases.text: The paragraph breaking algorithm considers the complete sequence of words before choosing its line endings. Typography is a system of interdependent decisions, including hyphenation, flexible spaces, and the relationship between consecutive lines. A local decision which fills the current line can create an unnecessarily loose following line. Mathematical documents require consistent composition across different widths, without inserting explicit newlines into the original source.
